structuredContent.body:
## Summary

hash_test0 used the default test configuration, which disables both native-literal extensions. Consequently, the quick Nat and String constructors returned None, and the existing equality/hash loop compared absent values instead of literal expressions.

This test-only change:

- makes the disabled behavior explicit;
- enables both extensions before creating a fresh export/DAG;
- requires successful Nat/String literal construction and checks their variants and stored payloads;
- retains the repeated-value equality, hash, and interning checks.

## Validation

- cargo test --offline --locked hash_test0
- cargo test --offline --locked — 38 library tests passed; 0 failed; 8 doc tests ignored

## Evidence

The evidence below is pinned to the immutable Lean Assurance Lab commit that recorded this finding and repair:

- [test-effectiveness assessment](https://github.com/phiferd/lean-assurance-lab/blob/773f2cac989e54fcb846bc87e3789985a1fd0e7e/results/research/nanoda-test-nonvacuity-1/test-effectiveness-assessment.json)
